name: deco-tweaks
note: Owner tweaks 2026-11-08: the wildflower patch without a green mat (blend on grass); the Mulberry Tree's ready state in white blossom (its ready state was indistinguishable); the Black Fog as a cloud that bleeds past its tile so neighbours overlap.

wildflower-patch.prompt: CAMERA CONTROL: the FIRST attached image is this game's approved BARREL, cut on magenta: draw the subject from the SAME camera as that barrel (mostly from the front, a little from above, a top showing only as a narrow strip), at the same rendering and daylight. CAMERA AND STYLE REFERENCE: the SECOND attached panel is a building from this game, drawn in the game's camera (top-down three-quarter: the object seen from the front and from above at once, verticals straight up) and in its painterly storybook rendering; match that camera and rendering exactly, the same brush texture, the same warm full daylight from high up and a little left, the same soft shadows only in the recesses.   The THIRD attached image is this game's OAK TREE: its leaf green is the reference for the grass blades. SUBJECT: a loose WILDFLOWER PATCH: a dozen small flowers in white, yellow and blue (never pink) on thin stems with only a few single thin grass blades between them, NO green mat, NO mound, NO patch of ground under them: the flat magenta shows between every stem, so that on the board the real grass tile shows through; lying low so a character can walk over it, no edge or border. Keep it SIMPLE and at the game's scale: this prop is seen 45 pixels wide on the board next to a barrel, so big plain shapes, flat areas of colour, thick outlines, no fine detail. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid and a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle, one board tile. Draw the SUBJECT alone, standing on the ground inside that box and filling it well (it may rise above the box, never past the box's sides), seen in the game's camera, square-on (its front face parallel to the bottom edge of the image, never turned at a diagonal), with a soft contact shadow directly under it; leave every other pixel pure solid magenta: no grass, no ground, no scene, no frame, no text.
